product.title: Lascar EL-USB-RT Temperature Humidity and Dew Point USB Sensor
features: Dew Point Indication via Windows Control Software
description: When plugged into the USB port of a PC installed with the purpose designed software under 32-bit versions of Windows XP, Vista and 7, EL-USB-RT measures temperature and relative humidity from -20° to +70°C (-4° to +158°F) and 0 to 100%RH. The PC displays the temperature, humidity and dew point(the temperature at which water vapor present in the air begins to condense) in real-time and saves it to a file which can store up to 7 day's worth of data.

review.text: I can't believe a freaking temperature/humidity monitor costs this much.  But it does work.  There's code on github to make it work with linux, and that works pretty well.
review.title: expensive, but it works
